name: SegmentedMatSprinkler
description: A periodic engine distributing coating material of particles having CohFrictMatSeg. Determines the particles to cover by ray tracing algorithm.

attributes.name: alpha
attributes.description: Angle (degrees) defining width of the stream in the first direction.

attributes.name: alphaResolution
attributes.description: How many searching lines scan one cross-section in first direction

attributes.name: beta
attributes.description: Angle (degrees) defining width of the stream in the second direction.

attributes.name: betaResolution
attributes.description: How many searching lines scan one cross-section in first direction

attributes.name: feedRate
attributes.description: Volume of the material distributed per second (unit is $1000^3$ smaller than volume unit of the simulation, see

attributes.name: initRun
attributes.description: Run the first time we are called as well.

attributes.name: iterPeriod
attributes.description: Periodicity criterion using step number (deactivated if <= 0)

attributes.name: lostVolume
attributes.description: Released volume that did not reach any target.

attributes.name: nDo
attributes.description: Limit number of executions by this number (deactivated if negative)

attributes.name: prevTime
attributes.description: Virtual time of the last run. Compared to the

attributes.name: realPeriod
attributes.description: Periodicity criterion using real (wall clock, computation, human) time in seconds (deactivated if <=0)

attributes.name: refDir
attributes.description: Reference direction of SegmentedMatSprinkler (center of the stream). It should not be directly modified. When the direction of sprinkler is rotated in setVersors function, this direction is taken as reference.

attributes.name: releasedVolume
attributes.description: Volume released by the sprinkler since the begining of its work.

attributes.name: virtPeriod
attributes.description: Periodicity criterion using virtual (simulation) time (deactivated if <= 0)

methods.name: setVersors
methods.description: Sets versors of lines searching for the surfaces of closest spheres. Should always be used after changing any parameters of SegmentedMatSprinkler other than feedRate.
